notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing card can be viewed, but the flow does not open it for editing.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated letter badge instead of the favicon.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are unsupported and therefore unsearchable.
REF-BM-14: No #tag search syntax is implemented.
REF-BM-15: No Boolean operators or parenthesised search expressions are parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no action over all bookmarks matching the current filter.
REF-BM-22: Bookmarks are always newest-first; no selectable sort key is provided.
REF-BM-23: Markdown notes cannot be written or rendered.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: There is no reversible archive operation distinct from deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
